name: Check product barcodes meet GS1 standards
summary: Checks every active product's barcode against GS1 rules (digits only, 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits, a correct check digit, no two products sharing one) and flags what fails. A corrected GTIN goes to the product master only after a person approves it. Crons read and queue; nothing changes until approval.

crons.name: check-barcodes
crons.summary: Check each active product's barcode and store the findings (20:00 UTC is 6 or 7 am in eastern Australia).

crons.name: queue-fixes
crons.summary: Queue one barcode update for each corrected GTIN a person has recorded, for approval.

draft_ops_note: Reads only. The check writes its findings to the workflow store, which reaches nobody outside the business.

unleashed.covers: product list (first page), single product read, barcode update queued for approval

gaps: Unleashed calls are signed by core (api-auth-id, api-auth-signature, client-type), and the workflow is tested offline against a fake network only. Nothing has run against a real Unleashed account yet, so the first run on a client's account is a read the owner watches.
Only the first page of products is read (200 by default). The kit's GET /Products maps pageSize but no page number, so a larger catalogue is checked in part and the run says so.
The barcode update posts the whole product as read with only Barcode changed. Unleashed's POST body rules for a partial product are not proven; it needs a sandbox run before approval is trusted.

Before a barcode send, the check re-reads the product and holds 10 fields to what the cron read (Barcode, ProductCode, ProductDescription, Obsolete, IsSellable, Notes, Comments, BinLocation, DefaultSellPrice, DefaultPurchasePrice). A change to any other field in Unleashed between queue and approval is still overwritten, because the runtime checks at most 10 values.
No kit verb records a corrected GTIN into the barcode-fixes store yet. tools/workflow.ts is core, so this stays open until the CRM shell or a core verb writes those records.

Fishbowl and Odoo have no mapped operations in the kit that cover barcodes (Odoo has one, GET /web/version). Their barcode checks are not built; Fishbowl's help centre returned no pages and Odoo's evidence is community forum threads.

GTIN allocation from GS1 (new numbers, company prefix), barcode symbol generation, print quality verification, retailer and EDI sync (EANCOM) and renewals are judgment or non-platform steps. Nothing automates them here.
Batch and lot number checks (length, expiry dates on BatchNumbers) are left out: they are traceability, not the barcode check this workflow names.
Confirm the workflow steps and platform coverage with the business before enabling its crons.
